content.short: Tally is an all-in-one tool that helps DAOs govern.
content.description: Tally consolidates three core capabilities into a single DAO tool: a customizable payout system for distributions inside and outside a DAO, an on-chain governance module that simplifies voting and supports proposals and outcome tallying, and the ability to recognize usernames (ENS) instead of addresses when contributing to DAOs. By making governance easier and participation more fluid, Tally helps decentralized organizations grow, encourage broader contributions, and strengthen connections among members.
content.meta: Tally helps DAOs manage governance workflows, proposals, and voting in one interface. Discover Tally and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
